value.rationale: The cited source leaves a mathematically natural stationarity question unanswered: the relative mixture of two monopoly states under arbitrarily rare positive intrinsic quality. The result gives a sharp topological yes/no criterion for simple quality-proportional weights and a signed change at the natural q1+q2=1 boundary. It identifies a substantive finite-state social-network mechanism rather than a routine numeric invariant.
